value.name: Verb sense inventory (PropBank roleset x concreteness)
value.description: The 83 senses the stimuli instantiate: transitive PropBank rolesets of the 40 verbs (62 rolesets, idiomatic senses and senses favoring non-'the' determiners set aside), split into concrete and abstract sub-senses where both readings were available (paper §2.1). Each entry's ontologyTypeRef is the roleset's typeDef in the Layers PropBank ontology; its features carry the posterior p(sense | verb) of both Experiment 1 fits.
